The '''Singing Stone''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that can be obtained only by donating 21 [[Minerals]] to the [[Museum]].  It plays musical notes when {{key|right-clicked}}. It can be removed once placed by holding left-click, or by using a [[Tools|tool]].

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
